from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named individual or entity involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="The name of the party")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Their role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Defendant, Applicant)")

class MonetaryOrder(BaseModel):
    """A specific monetary amount awarded or ordered in the judgment."""
    amount: str = Field(description="The exact amount as written (e.g., '39360 元')")
    recipient: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who receives the payment")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who makes the payment")
    purpose: str = Field(description="What the money is for (e.g., 'Compensation', 'Litigation Fees')")

class JudgmentCase(BaseModel):
    """Evidence extracted from a single judgment document for matching against results."""
    case_number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The official case number")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The name of the court")
    case_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="The type of case (e.g., Criminal, Civil, Administrative)")
    parties: List[Party] = Field(description="All key parties named in the document")
    ruling_summary: Optional[str] = Field(description="The core ruling text (e.g., 'Retrial Application Rejected')")
    monetary_orders: List[MonetaryOrder] = Field(description="Specific financial orders found in the text")
    penalties: Optional[str] = Field(description="Non-monetary penalties like imprisonment or revocation")
    appeal_status: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stage of proceedings (e.g., 'Second Instance', 'Retrial Review')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: List[JudgmentCase]
